title: Hydrogen storage in activated carbon materials: Role of the nanoporous texture
material_description: Carbon C | Carbon C, activated carbon in development
notes: bet_surface_area_m2_g holds paper's "total surface area" (N2 77 K); paper does not state BET. uptake_type unspecified (no excess/absolute in text). Pore volume below 0.7 nm is V_DR(CO2) from Table 1, Dubinin-Radushkevitch applied to CO2 adsorption at 273 K, P/P0 < 0.03. Surface area is the paper's TSA column, footnoted 'total surface area'; the paper never states a BET determination, so surface_area_method is unspecified and extraction_confidence is 4 rather than 5. Reconciliation C (2026-11-09): V_DR(CO2) is stored both as ultramicropore_volume_cm3_g (cutoff 0.7 nm, stated on p. 2745) and as micropore_volume_co2_cm3_g (DR on CO2 at 273 K, Table 1 footnote); pore_volume_method/probe gas carry the primary N2-DR volume. skeletal_density_g_cm3 = 2 is the real density the authors assume for all carbons from ref. [14] to compute the sample volume in the compressed-gas correction, not a measurement on these samples. Schema v2 coding from extractor B, checked against the paper: 1.5 g sample; degassing 'carefully heat treated under vacuum' with no temperature or duration; H2 apparatus not named; free volume from the empty-cell compressed-gas volume at every pressure plus the sample volume; replicates_reported from the error bars on every 1 and 10 bar point in Fig. 2(a) (magnitude not printed). Table 1 values at several pressures with no plotted isotherm form one isotherm per sample (n.d. points not counted).
extractor: v0.1 rows and agent B (claude-opus-5-5), reconciled by C (claude-opus-5-5)
free_volume_calibration: volume of compressed gas in the empty cell determined at every pressure following the adsorption procedure (H2, 77 K implied); sample volume from real density d = 2 g cm-3 [14]
